label: Every being foundational at w exists at every world accessible from w
paraphrase: Verdict 'necessary' at the foundational case, analyst formulation: every being that is foundational at w (exists at w; represented esse equal to represented essence; not composed of matter and form; esse received in no principle; first in SIMPLY_PRIOR_1; no CAUSE_2 of its esse; incorruptible simply, that is, no in-subject potency to non-being; under no being's POWER_OVER_ESSE_1) exists at every world accessible from w (NECESSARY_2 de re, relative to the frame's accessibility). A universal conditional: it does not assert that any being is foundational.
